responsibility: Declares `AST::Builder`, a convenience interface for programmatically constructing Rust AST fragments from one shared `location_t`. The header defines the public helper methods for creating common expressions, statements, paths, types, qualifiers, struct fields, and wildcard patterns, providing a lightweight node-synthesis API used by frontend-generated code such as macro-related AST construction rather than the main hand-written parser.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `AST::Builder` interface and its node-construction helper signatures, while the same-stem `.cc` file provides the out-of-line implementations that actually instantiate the requested AST nodes.
